main_text.p: quæ sub Vespasiano, consule Augusto, per Titum Cæsarem consummata est, anni CCCCLxxx. & iii. Prædictum id olim Dan.9. est à Daniele, qui ab instauratione templi usque in eversionem Lx. & ix. hebdomadas{a} futuras pronuntiaverat. A die autem a anno- mm. captivitatis ludæorum, usque in tempus restitutæ civitatis, fuerunt anni c'c Lx. Hoc temporum tractu, Hefter atq; ludith fuisse arbitramur. Quarum quidem actus, quibus potissimum regibus connectam, non facile perspexerim. Nam cum Hefter sub Artaxerxe{b} rege referatur, porro du-Arta-xerxeu ap pellant os hujus nominis Persarum reges fuisse Lxx, quæ reperi, multa cunctatio est, cujus hæc tem- poribus applicetur. Mihi tamen visum est, huic Artaxerxi,{c} sub quo Hierosolyma est Ebraei Afveri. restituta, Hefter historiam conectere, quæc qui Mnemon, dante fuit verisimilis: ut si sub priore Artaxerxe fuisset, cujus{e} tempora complexus est, nullam tam illustris fœminæ mentionem idest, Memor cognominatur. nem{f} reruliset, maxime cum ab illo Artaxerxe inhibitam templi ædificationem, sicut supra memoravimus, constet: neque Hefter-palsura fuerit tu, si in illius matrimonio monio tum fuisset. Nunc gesta edifierā. E- d Quia haut fuit verifimile. Sig.F. e qui ejus idem. rat ea tepestate regi in matrimonio Vastis quædam,

page.notes: Running head read as "SVLPICII SEVERI" from the spaced letters; the letters after SVLP are partly obscured. Marginal notes are heavily abbreviated and partly broken across lines; the reading "a anno- mm." and "Arta-xerxeu ap pellant" is uncertain. The text is dense and several words near the binding (e.g. "monio tum fuisset", "Hefter-palsura fuerit tu") are doubtful and may be misread. The superscript after "das" was read as {a}, which is uncertain. The reference "CCCCLxxx. & iii." is copied as printed; the final numeral may read differently. Note "d" on "dante" and note "e" are the only other reference marks visible. The footnote "{a} Dan. 9." was added as a placeholder and is not printed on the page; it should be removed.
